messages:
Lina (compliance): Auditor asks for evidence after RBAC change: redaction-before-export, KMS envelope-wrap, per-file sha256, chain-of-custody, vuln-triage linked to IR 2026-IR-47. Can we assemble by EOD?

Maria (sec-eng): I will prepare redaction rules, sanitized samples, manifest.jsonl and a GPG-signed manifest. Quick: per-file hashes or a single bundle hash?

auditor_jones: Per-file SHA256s please. Also include who exported, timestamp, KMS key id/version, and evidence that redaction ran before export.

Ajay (infra): Plan: export to s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/. Add object metadata (exported-by, exported-at, kms-key-id, kms-key-version), envelope-encrypt each object with KMS, compute sha256 per .log.enc, manifest.jsonl (one JSON object per line), sign manifest with GPG.

Sam (sec-ops): Note: RBAC change created ephemeral svc accounts svc-rw-data and svc-metrics; we rotated their creds during the window. IR ticket 2026-IR-47 (token leak). I'll include iam-change.diff and rotation logs.

Maria (sec-eng): Redaction rules (CI-tested):

# redact emails and SSN-like patterns
s/email\\S*@\\S+/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g
s/\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b/[REDACTED_SSN]/g
# redact header user ids
s/(user_id=)[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/\\1[REDACTED_ID]/g

Sample sanitized log line:
2026-03-20T15:02:13Z svc-api request_id=abc123 user_id=[REDACTED_ID] email=[REDACTED_EMAIL] action=get-embedding duration_ms=42

Ajay (infra): Traceable export command we ran: aws s3 cp --recursive /var/log/processed/ s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/ --metadata exported-by=ajay,exported-at=2026-03-20T15:10:00Z. KMS key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234, version 3. Hashing snippet: for f in *.log.enc; do sha256sum \"$f\" >> manifest.jsonl; done. Sign with: gpg --output manifest.jsonl.sig --sign manifest.jsonl.

ops-bot: Export completed: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/ (12 files) :white_check_mark:

auditor_jones: Please attach gpg_pubkey.asc and a KMS key policy snippet showing principals allowed to Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Also provide exported IAM change JSON or a screenshot, and vuln-triage.csv linking CVEs to PRs/commits.

Maria (sec-eng): Will include gpg_pubkey.asc, KMS policy snippet, redact_test.py (to replay deterministic redaction) and vuln-triage.csv. Example vuln-triage row: CVE-2026-0421,tokenizer-lib,commit abcdef1,pinned to 1.2.3 + sanitization test,verified staging 2026-03-18.

Sam (sec-ops): IR timeline PDF attached and will link the bundle to 2026-IR-47 for chain-of-custody.

Maria (sec-eng): Manifest.jsonl will contain lines like: {"file":"svc-api-2026-03-20.log.enc","sha256":"<hex>","exported_by":"ajay","exported_at":"2026-03-20T15:10:00Z","kms_key_id":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-1234","kms_key_version":"3","signed_by":"maria"}. Also adding audit-note.txt (human readable) and signing it.

auditor_jones: Also want a short description explaining why redaction is deterministic and how to run the test harness.

Maria (sec-eng): Deterministic because the same ordered regex rules run in CI; redact_test.py + sample raw/expected files will assert outputs match. Example: $ python redact_test.py samples/raw.log samples/expected_sanitized.log -> OK.

Ajay (infra): KMS policy snippet (sanitized): {"KeyId":"abcd-1234","Policy":{"Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowEncrypt","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/infra-exporter"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Effect":"Allow"},{"Sid":"AllowDecrypt","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/sec-ops"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Effect":"Allow"}]}}

Maria (sec-eng): Bundle contents (2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip): samples/raw_and_sanitized_examples/, manifest.jsonl, manifest.jsonl.sig, iam-change.diff, cloud-audit-event.json, ir-2026-IR-47-timeline.pdf, vuln-triage.csv, redact_test.py, gpg_pubkey.asc, audit-note.txt, README-mapping-to-SOC-controls.md. Will map files to CC6/CC7 in README.

Sam (sec-ops): Uploading bundle now and will comment on IR ticket.

ops-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip (signed)

auditor_jones: Received. We'll validate per-file sha256s against manifest and verify the GPG signature. If anything else is needed we'll ping. Thanks.

Lina (compliance): Please mark items as \"evidence:prepared\" in the compliance tracker when uploaded. Thanks everyone.
